prompt.en: Explain the position this unit holds on whether a believer can be demonized, and name at least one other view.

prompt.fr: Expliquez la position que tient cette unité sur la question de savoir si un croyant peut être démonisé, et nommez au moins une autre position.
prompt.sw: Eleza msimamo wa kipindi hiki kuhusu kama muumini anaweza kupagawa na pepo, na taja angalau maoni mengine moja.

prompt.en: Answer the cessationist or the rationalist objection to deliverance.

prompt.fr: Répondez à l'objection cessationniste ou rationaliste contre la délivrance.
prompt.sw: Jibu pingamizi la wanaoamini kukoma kwa karama au la warazini dhidi ya ukombozi.

prompt.en: Explain why this unit cautions against strategic-level warfare or generational-curse rituals.

prompt.sw: Eleza kwa nini kipindi hiki kinaonya dhidi ya vita vya kimkakati au ibada za laana za vizazi.

prompt.sw: Taja angalau desturi tatu za ushirikina au zenye madhara zinazopaswa kukataliwa.

prompt.en: Describe at least three safeguards for a safe and biblical deliverance ministry.

prompt.sw: Eleza angalau mambo matatu ambayo mchungaji mwenye hekima anafanya katika kujibu hofu ya Rosa ya laana.
